findings.finding: The FY26 NOK 1.5bn revenue target needs H2 TOI of NOK 788m (+23% on H2 2025's 643m) while only NOK 426m of backlog was scheduled for 2026 delivery at 30 June, so H2 book-and-ship must reach ~NOK 362m against ~266m in H2 2025 (+36%); consensus (NOK 1.47bn) already sits below the target and the Nortek cutback cites FX and a weak science market - a trim or softening of the target is the more likely guidance change.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Only two prints since the March 2026 IPO; the target was 'on track'/'realistic' at both. Q2 (target firmed, +22% revenue) +11.0%; Q1 ('solid underlying', margin below target) -6.5%. No history of a target change.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: consensus at NOK 1.47bn is already ~2% below the target, and the stock is below its NOK 21 IPO price at 19.30. Fully priced would look like consensus at or below NOK 1.45bn and no Fidelity build into the print; neither holds, so a formal cut still lands as news on a two-analyst name.
findings.independence: Nortek restructuring release citing a ~10% USD/NOK decline and the need to lower the cost base (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=685426); USD/NOK Yahoo series Q3 avg 9.50 vs 10.09 (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/NOK%3DX?range=2y&interval=1d).

findings.finding: Q3 2025 was the group's weakest quarter (TOI NOK 282m, adj. EBITA NOK 49m, 17% margin; Sensors 237m, Robotics 51m), while Robotics ran at NOK 97m in Q2 2026 on defense contracts plus MRV, so Q3 2026 should headline high-teens-to-20%+ y/y growth, as the Q2 release did ('Revenue growth of 22%').
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 headlined 22% revenue growth and the stock rose 11.0%; Q1 headlined 'solid underlying performance' with flat-ish revenue and fell 6.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The comparison is public and partly priced, but there is no published Q3 consensus to set against it; on a retail-heavy (3,000+ IPO shareholders) name at $0.24m/day the headline growth rate itself moves the open, as Q2 showed.
findings.independence: Q2 segment figures (Robotics 97m vs 29m) in the same report; Teledyne Q3 2026 marine instrumentation only ~+2% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001094285/000109428526000059/tdy-20260927.htm) - cuts the other way for Sensors, so the gain is Robotics-only.

findings.finding: USD/NOK averaged 9.50 in Q3 2026 against 10.09 in Q3 2025 (-5.8%), a translation headwind on reported revenue and a larger one on Nortek's EBITA (USD revenue, NOK costs), but slightly better than Q2 2026's 9.43, so no worse than the conditions under which the target was reaffirmed in August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FX was cited as a drag in both Q1 and Q2 releases; Q1 (FX-hit) -6.5%, Q2 (FX-hit but strong growth) +11.0% - FX itself has not decided a reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the series is public and the company quantified the sensitivity in Q2. Kept small because it lands inside guided conditions.
findings.independence: Company Q2 report: '10% adverse exchange rate effect results in an approximately 10% reduction in EBITA' (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/attachment?messageId=679560&attachmentId=330896).

findings.finding: Nortek cut ~10% of its global workforce and books ~NOK 8m one-time restructuring cost across Q3 and Q4, citing the ~10% USD/NOK decline and redirecting resources to navigation - a signal that the Sensors core (science/current-measurement) is soft in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The release itself (3 Nov) took the stock from 20.45 to 17.60 over three sessions (-14%) before a +13% rebound on 9 Nov; net 20.45 -> 19.30 (-5.6%).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced - the tape already reacted -14% and recovered most of it. What remains unpriced is how much of the Sensors weakness shows in Q3 margin; the one-off itself (NOK 8m vs ~NOK 300m adj. EBITA run-rate) is likely excluded from adjusted EBITA.

findings.finding: FMR (Fidelity) raised its holding from 7.13% (25 Sep, 13,713,359 shares) to 7.89% (9 Nov, 15,166,870 shares) into the print - a disclosed institutional buyer adding ~1.45m shares, about six weeks of median volume.
findings.why_not_priced: The 9 Nov threshold date coincides with a +13% session on 323k shares, so much of the buying is in the price; residual value is that a large holder is not distributing into the print.

findings.finding: Folketrygdfondet lent out 147,000 GENO shares on 11 November, the day before results, taking its net holding to 9,526,439 shares (4.96%) - borrow demand into the print, below any short-disclosure threshold.
findings.original_quote: Folketrygdfondet har i dag 11. november 2026, lånt ut 147 000 aksjer i General Oceans ASA. Etter utlånet har Folketrygdfondet netto 9 526 439 aksjer, tilsvarende 4,96% av aksjene i selskapet.
findings.why_not_priced: Filed in Norwegian only, mid-session the day before results; 0.08% of shares is small and the borrower's purpose is unknown, so it is sized near zero.
findings.independence: SSR shows no position >=0.5% (https://ssr.finanstilsynet.no/api/v2/instruments), consistent with a sub-threshold borrow.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is ~0 (no anchor, +0.14 from a flat run-up) and the 5-day +6.45% is the post-restructuring rebound; the findings lean slightly negative on the guide while the headline comparison leans positive, so nothing here strongly fights the price.
language_note: The Folketrygdfondet share-lending flagging (11 Nov) was published in Norwegian only ('Flagging i General Oceans ASA'); every other primary document, including the reports and the Nortek restructuring, is English-only, and no Norwegian press coverage of the name was reachable.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance findings 11/17 on sign, 9.0% median move on a change): target finding raised from -1.0 to -1.2 and abs_move_pct from 8.5 to 9.0.
'Understatement is the systematic error': abs_move_pct kept at least at the name's own median (8.75) rather than below it.
'A finding the market has been told is worth ~0': Nortek restructuring -0.3 -> -0.2 (already reacted on the tape) and FX -0.2 -> -0.1 (inside conditions the target was reaffirmed under).
Reported-quarter comparison finding trimmed +0.8 -> +0.6 because the quarterly bar is unsourced (cap) and a verified comparison is not a predicted reaction; p_up 48 -> 47.
Folketrygdfondet lending -0.2 -> -0.1: a truncated-zero register means no anchor, not evidence of a building short.
